description: `prose --output json cron` prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope whose suggestedArgv is `cli job create --help`: cron expressions are not supported.

problem.action: A schedule job runs every interval_seconds seconds, not on a cron expression. Use `cli job create`, then add --spec-file FILE; `prose --output json cli job create --help` shows the options of `cli job create`.

details.reason: `cron` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli job create --help`? A schedule is a job of type schedule created from a JSON spec; it runs every interval_seconds seconds (86400 = daily), not on a cron expression. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
